text:
Devon (partnerships): FYI ACME Reseller's batch PO to Azure marketplace failed validation. Portal rejects multi-signer POs. Customer has a hard go-live on Friday. :grimacing:
Hannah (finance): Oof. Can you paste the exact portal error and a snippet of the PO header? we need vendor id + currency to route tills.
Devon (partnerships): Portal response:
```
<error code="PO_VALIDATION_FAIL">multiple_signers_not_allowed</error>
```
PO snippet:
```
<PurchaseOrder id="PO-98432">
  <Vendor>ACME-RESELLER</Vendor>
  <Currency>USD</Currency>
  <Signatures>
    <Signature role="buyer">corp-buyer</Signature>
    <Signature role="reseller">acme-procurement</Signature>
  </Signatures>
</PurchaseOrder>
```
Maya (partner-ops): This is the EDI/portal flow. Our CSV normalizer consolidates signers for bulk uploads, but EDI passes straight to the marketplace with no transformation.
Ilya (eng - integrations): Short-term engineering option: add a lightweight transform in the EDI adapter that collapses Signatures into a single effective signer and attach original signers as header X-Original-Signers: ["corp-buyer", "acme-procurement"]. Low-risk change, but needs legal + accounting confirmation. ETA 48-72h for hotfix and rollout to staging.
Luca (legal): If we mutate signer data, we need contractual cover. We can draft a one-page addendum authorizing signature consolidation for portal compatibility and obligating us to publish the original signer list to both parties. Must include explicit consent from reseller and buyer or a clause in the reseller MSA.
Hannah (finance): Also check tax/billing entity implications. If reseller signer maps billing to reseller entity, consolidation could change tax handling. I'll coordinate with accounting ops now.
Marco (vendor success): ACME procurement says they won't reissue POs. They want either a portal admin override or a documented exception. They're breathing down our partner ops team.
Devon (partnerships): Opened ticket with marketplace partner ops: MP-90042 - "PO rejected: multiple_signers_not_allowed". MarketplaceBot: "MP-90042 created. Current SLA 72h for partner exceptions."
Maya (partner-ops): Two-track plan proposed:
- Path A (fast, manual): Request portal admin exception for this PO(s) while we sort legal/accounting. Might take 24-72h depending on partner workload.
- Path B (scoped engineering): Implement EDI transform + audit header + self-service audit page showing original signers. Requires legal addendum + finance sign-off. ~3 business days to deploy if we approve scope.
Ilya (eng - integrations): Tech detail: transform would be a single XSLT step or a micro-middleware that rewrites the XML before the marketplace gateway. Add an immutable audit record in S3 with key PO-98432-original-signers.json. I can prototype today.
Luca (legal): I'll draft the addendum and a vendor acknowledgement template. If we go Path A, we still want the addendum as a follow-up to cover future automations.
Hannah (finance): Accounting ops: "If we change signer, we must not flip the invoice payee mapping without a signed billing entitlement. We can accept signer consolidation if the underlying billingEntity element remains unchanged. If signing party == billingEntity then no go without new docs."
Devon (partnerships): So decision: request emergency portal exception for immediate go-live AND run engineering change concurrently; legal to prepare addendum for post-hoc consent.
Marco (vendor success): ACME agreed to a temporary waiver if marketplace grants exception; they signed a short email acknowledgement to avoid re-uploads. Sent to partner-ops and copied marketplace rep.
Maya (partner-ops): Escalating MP-90042 with urgency flag and attaching ACME acknowledgement. Also created internal change request CHG-4571 for EDI transform.
MarketplaceBot: "MP-90042 status: escalated -> partner review. ETA update in 6h."
Ilya (eng - integrations): I'll open PR for the adapter transform (branch: hotfix/edi-signer-collapse) and include unit tests for signature preservation. Will add header X-Original-Signers and store original XML to the audit bucket.
Luca (legal): Drafted addendum v0.1 and shared in DM. Key clause: "Redwood may normalize signer metadata for marketplace compatibility while preserving an immutable record of original signatories and notifying affected parties." Will iterate with Hannah for tax language.
Hannah (finance): Accounting ops confirmed: if billingEntity element is present and != consolidated signer, it's safe. If missing or equals reseller signer, we need the addendum or a billing letter.
Devon (partnerships): Great. Action list: Marco -> confirm ACME acknowledgement filed (done); Maya -> continue MP escalation & CHG-4571 tracking; Ilya -> PR + staging deploy; Luca -> finalize addendum and run legal review; Hannah -> finalize billing impact and sign-off. Follow up in 6 hours or sooner if MP responds. :white_check_mark:
